description: Calculate Iranian salary, property-transfer, inheritance or rental tax. For inheritance: rates depend on asset kind and heir class (arts. 17–18 ق.م.م) with NO general monetary exemption, and pre/post-1395 death dates differ — ask before calling. Property basis is ارزش معاملاتی, not market price.

no_other_income.description: Rental: individual landlord with no other income (art. 57 exemption).

residential_under_exempt_area.description: Rental: residential unit within the exempt floor-area (150m² Tehran / 200m² elsewhere).

value_toman.description: Property value (property_transfer) or taxable asset value (inheritance).

name: calculate_tax
title: محاسبهٔ مالیات — Calculate Iranian taxes
